# Grounding
`gitboard` serves as a platform for git-centric project analysis and management. The system's capabilities are organized into functional objectives that drive its automated workflows.
### Product Objectives
| Objective | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| Git Operations & Integration | Manages local repository metadata enrichment via `localgit` and provides adapters for remote services like GitHub and GitLab through `remotegit`. |
| Project Discovery & Sync | Aggregates project selection and discovery information using `syncproj`. |
| Automated Analysis | Performs root cause analysis and log summarization through `triage`, and investigates removable branches via `pruneagent`. |
| Inference & Communication | Facilitates LLM-based interactions through an OpenAI-compatible `llm` client. |
| Infrastructure & Observability | Provides HTTP serving capabilities via `server` and manages OpenTelemetry tracing and inference dumps via `observability`. |
